#!/usr/bin/env python3
# script to pivot Eurostat raw data into city-indicator matrix
import csv
import os

import pandas as pd

# read the raw spreadsheet
raw_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t02_eurostat_raw.csv")
df = pd.read_csv(raw_path)

# pivot to city-year matrix – one column per indicator
pivot = df.pivot(index=["city_id", "city_name", "year"],
                 columns="indicator_id",
                 values="value")
pivot = pivot.reset_index()  # make city_id, city_name, year columns

# write the output as RFC‑4180 compliant
out_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv")
pivot.to_csv(out_path,
             index=False,
             quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
